summary: This directory serves as the root entry point and foundational utility layer for the package. It exports core schema definitions, type utilities, and shared configurations, providing a central access point for consistent data modeling and type safety across the entire application.
responsibilities: Expose primary domain interfaces and schema definitions
Provide type-safe utilities for object manipulation
Standardize configuration and type normalization logic
Facilitate access to foundational structural types and identifiers
relationships: Core type definitions provide the foundation for consistent schema modeling across the package.
Utility functions leverage exported type definitions to perform operations like object normalization and property filtering.
The directory aggregates multiple domain-specific modules, ensuring that consumers have unified access to the package's internal data structures.
designDecisions: Use of barrel files for centralized module exports
Integration of nominal branding for path type safety
Colocation of type-level transformations with runtime utilities
Strict separation between domain entities and general-purpose type infrastructure
